name: Chiruwi
body:
CHIRUWI
CR 18

A sickening sight lumbers toward you, a corpse of a man cleanly bisected from head to toe. Half his body has been replaced with wax, and the other half is clearly in a state of partial decomposition. Despite this, it approaches you with striking speed…

XP 153,600
N Medium undead
Init +2; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +23

DEFENSE

AC 30, touch 26, flat-footed 24, (+6 Dex, +4 natural)
hp 228 (24d8+120)
Fort +20, Ref +18, Will +21
Defensive Abilities cold resistance 10, electricity resistance 10; Immune acid, undead traits
SR 29
Weaknesses vulnerability to fire, heat susceptibility

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee wax axe +14/+9/+4 (6d6+8/19–20 slashing)
Special Attacks finger of death, waxystrike, wrestle

STATISTICS

Str 24, Dex 23, Con -, Int 9, Wis 13, Cha 20
Base Atk +18; CMB +25; CMD +41
Feats Improved Unarmed Strike, Improved Grapple, Greater Grapple, Nimble Moves, Acrobatic Steps, Power Attack, Cleave, Great Cleave, Improved Bull Rush, Greater Bull Rush, Improved Sunder, Greater Sunder
Skills Acrobatics 24, Intimidate 11, Knowledge (nature) 24, Perception 13
Languages Common

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Finger of Death (Sp)

Once per hour, the chiruwi can point at one creature within 60 feet of it, affecting it as a finger of death spell (no save allowed).

Heat Susceptibility (Ex)

As beings composed partially of wax, chiruwi are particularly vulnerable to heat. If a chiruwi takes 30 or more Fire damage from a single source, it has a -5 penalty on attacks, saves, and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

Wrestle (Ex, Sp)

The chiruwi challenges those it meets to a wrestling contest (only one creature per group). The creature it chooses cannot already have Knowledge (nature) as a class skill. A foe who loses this contest is affected by a finger of death spell (no saving throw allowed). Should the challenged creature win, it gains Knowledge (nature) as a class skill. The match is an opposed grapple check, best 2 out of 3.

Waxy Strike (Ex)

Targets struck by the chiruwi’s wax axe attack are encased in opaque wax, and are considered blinded and helpless until the beginning of the chiruwi’s next turn.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization any
Treasure standard

Known as half-people, chiruwi (also mangabangabana) are literally half a person, bisected down the middle with one leg, one arm, one eye, etc. Their other half consists of symmetrical duplicate formed of living wax. Scholars believe that chiruwi are the result of the horrifying, prolonged torture of an athlete by a necromancer, who replaces the athlete’s removed half with unliving wax. The reasoning goes that the necromancer takes particular delight in marring the perfection they see in the athlete.

Chiruwi carry hardened wax axes and defend themselves if they feel threatened, but they love nothing more than to challenge those they meet to wrestling matches. Those who lose suffer a terrible curse that often results in death while those who win are granted a great boon. They are also known to encase their foes in wax, something survivors have described as extremely unsettling.
